title: Exerciser run plan
description: Selects per-action origin variant (outliving vs ordinary vs daemon spawn; only process_spawn has variants) and timing (fixed inter-action delay; the canonical trace spec carries no spacing field, so the default is 0.0 — back-to-back, mirroring the harness replay). The driver cross-checks action ids and variant applicability against the trace spec (JSON Schema cannot cross-reference files).

inter_action_delay_s.description: Fixed delay in seconds slept between consecutive actions (not after the last). Wall clock never branches the action sequence.

join_timeout_s.description: Bounded wait for outstanding (outliving/daemon) children before the driver exits; v1 joins every child so no process outlives the run.

http.description: raw: plain HTTP request to the trace's own endpoint (T0 harness fetch shape); gateway: MCP tools/call JSON-RPC POST to the gateway /mcp endpoint (T1+ harness route).

gateway_url.description: Required with http=gateway (or set via the harness env knob GATEWAY_URL).

stdio_server_cmd.description: MCP stdio tool-server argv for the stdio twins (default: env MCP_SERVER_CMD, else python3 -u <repo>/targets/mcp-stdio/server.py; the harness container bakes /opt/inspection/mcp-fs/server.py).

actions.description: Per-action overrides keyed by canonical action id (cross-checked against the trace spec by the driver).

variant.description: Origin variant; only process_spawn actions accept a variant (driver-enforced).
